title: Building an AHB-Lite Protocol Monitor & Checker
description: Build a passive pipelined AHB-Lite monitor and a protocol checker, separate protocol rules from a testbench watchdog, triage a pre-broken slave, and prove the checks on fully pipelined traffic with a master mutant.

steps.title: Reconstruct pipelined transfers
steps.instructions: Complete `ahb_monitor.sv` so each accepted address phase (HREADY high, NONSEQ or SEQ) is paired with the data phase that completes at a later edge with HREADY high, counting wait states. Then uncomment the monitor instance in `tb_top` (testbench.sv).

steps.title: Add protocol assertions
steps.instructions: Complete `ahb_checker.sv`: the hold rules with their wait-state and cancel-after-ERROR exceptions, both directions of the two-cycle ERROR, the OKAY-during-waits rule, the HREADY watchdog labelled as testbench policy, and cover properties on the antecedents. Then uncomment the bind directive in `tb_top`.

steps.title: Triage the broken scenario
steps.instructions: Set `BROKEN_MODE` to 1 at the top of `testbench.sv` and rerun. Name the check that fires for each injected slave bug and the time it fires, without treating bounded slave latency as a protocol rule.

steps.title: Prove the checks on pipelined traffic
steps.instructions: Set `PIPELINED` to 1 (BROKEN_MODE back to 0) and confirm that every cover property is hit and nothing fails. Then set `MASTER_BUG` to 1 as well and find the assertion that names the master's illegal address change.
